'''Bahlea''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Bahlea was one of many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Bahlea married and bore a child named [[Rusa]].

Along with her husband, Bahlea raised their child until she fell ill with a feverish sickness. Setting out to retrieve a medicine derived from [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cat]] teeth, Bahlea's husband was killed by [[Flesh Raider]]s during his search. Later, her husband's final mission was completed by a young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] from the nearby [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] who brought Bahlea and Rusa the necessary teeth for the medicine.<ref name="TOR" />
